test_cases.title: Enter comments card on Home opens the Distributions page
acs: DERIVED: The Enter comments card on /Home.aspx opens /DistributionComments.aspx with h1 Distributions and title Distribution comments - Proficiency Testing - route /Home.aspx to /DistributionComments.aspx (also served at /CommentsEntry.aspx)
assumptions: The local debug sign-in bypass is active, so the user is already signed in when the site opens.
The card opens the page by postback.
The page also responds at /CommentsEntry.aspx; the address path after the click is not asserted beyond the two known routes.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1688/Home.aspx as a signed-in external user.
steps.expected: The home page loads with the h1 VETQAS Proficiency Testing.

steps.action: Look for the Enter comments card under the Results section.
steps.expected: The Enter comments card is visible.

steps.action: Click the Enter comments card.
steps.expected: The browser navigates to the address path /DistributionComments.aspx or /CommentsEntry.aspx.

steps.action: Read the main heading of the page that opened.
steps.expected: The h1 reads Distributions.

steps.action: Read the browser tab title.
steps.expected: The title reads Distribution comments - Proficiency Testing and no server error page is shown.

test_cases.title: Distributions comments page shows the search labels and buttons
acs: DERIVED: /DistributionComments.aspx shows the search labels Distribution Reference, Scheme Name and Scheme Code and the buttons SEARCH and SHOW ALL - route /DistributionComments.aspx
assumptions: The local debug sign-in bypass is active.
Search is read-only. Nothing is entered into the search boxes in this case.
No empty-state message was observed locally, so none is asserted.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1688/DistributionComments.aspx as a signed-in external user.
steps.expected: The page loads with the h1 Distributions and no server error page is shown.

steps.action: Read the labels of the search form.
steps.expected: The labels Distribution Reference, Scheme Name and Scheme Code are shown.

steps.action: Look for the SEARCH button.
steps.expected: The SEARCH button is visible.

steps.action: Look for the SHOW ALL button.
steps.expected: The SHOW ALL button is visible.

steps.action: Check the page for a server error message.
steps.expected: No server error page is shown and the h1 is still Distributions.

test_cases.title: Searching distribution comments with an unknown reference then SHOW ALL keeps the page working
acs: DERIVED: A search on /DistributionComments.aspx with a reference that does not exist returns the page without error, and SHOW ALL restores the list - route /DistributionComments.aspx
assumptions: The local debug sign-in bypass is active.
Search is read-only. No comment is entered, saved or submitted.
The empty-result message text is not recorded; only the page heading and search form are asserted.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1688/DistributionComments.aspx as a signed-in external user.
steps.expected: The page loads with the h1 Distributions.

steps.action: Type ZZ-NO-SUCH-REF in the Distribution Reference box.
steps.expected: The box shows ZZ-NO-SUCH-REF.

steps.action: Click the SEARCH button.
steps.expected: The page reloads with the h1 Distributions and no server error page is shown.

steps.action: Look at the results area below the search form.
steps.expected: No distribution row is listed for ZZ-NO-SUCH-REF.

steps.action: Click the SHOW ALL button.
steps.expected: The page reloads with the h1 Distributions and the search form is still shown.

steps.action: Read the Distribution Reference box.
steps.expected: The Distribution Reference box is cleared or empty.

test_cases.title: Distributions comments page keeps its heading after a reload and Back returns to Home
acs: DERIVED: /DistributionComments.aspx reloads without error and keeps the h1 Distributions, and browser Back returns to /Home.aspx - route /Home.aspx to /DistributionComments.aspx
assumptions: The local debug sign-in bypass is active.
The Enter comments card opens the page by postback, so browser Back may re-request the home page.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1688/Home.aspx as a signed-in external user.
steps.expected: The home page loads with the h1 VETQAS Proficiency Testing.

steps.action: Click the Enter comments card.
steps.expected: The h1 reads Distributions.

steps.action: Reload the page.
steps.expected: The page reloads and no server error page is shown.

steps.action: Read the main heading of the page.
steps.expected: The h1 is still Distributions.

steps.action: Select the browser Back button.
steps.expected: The browser returns to the address path /Home.aspx.

steps.action: Read the main heading of the page.
steps.expected: The h1 reads VETQAS Proficiency Testing and no server error page is shown.
